svg.title: By the numbers
svg.desc: Accuracy 79% to 91% on a fixed 3,965-image test set. 9 times lower end-to-end p50 latency, 1,415 ms to 156 ms. 181 images per second sustained on one L4 GPU, 12.6 times the production peak. 94 times classifier speed-up, ONNX Runtime 309.5 ms to TensorRT 3.3 ms.
svg.text: fixed test sets · production logs · load tests
